snippets.description: Skeleton plan.md of the master plan: Meta (incl. Home/Paused By), Context, Execution Rules, Routing, Status Board, Decision/Update Log; pointer to open-questions.md
Skeleton phases/Pn.md: Phase Context/Status, DoR checklist, skeleton phase marker, item sample with RAG markers + empty skeleton, Phase Handoff
Skeleton rolling handoff.md: Next with launch-block/Done/Remaining/Sources of truth/Open risks + devloop-telemetry keys
Fixed launch-block form “what to launch next”: Model/Thinking/Context/Essence table + bare code-block command, cold-start rules
3 Code Guidance patterns for typical item classes: anti-conformance/contract, anti-self-deception (gate), if-then escalation to D#
Skeleton plans/<ID>/roadmap.md - execution map: table Item|Batch|Launch|Model/Thinking|Owner gate, ready-made launch-blocks of batches/workflow, gate summary
Directory plans/<ID>/journal.jsonl (append-only NDJSON, P1.1): canonical CLI appending method via lib/task/journal.py, single entry scheme for manual backfill/backstop
Skeleton plans/<ID>/index.md (P1.2, optional): directory map + provenance findings/research→phase + key artifacts root/ - NOT status bearer/next
Skeleton plans/<ID>/closure/<Pn>.json (P8.1, opt-in `Closure Protocol | v1`): schema v1 of the phase closure report, filling rules, enum certificate classes
Layout-v2 append-only decision record with evidence, supersession, actor/model provenance, and consequences
Layout-v2 generated item-state projection: status and five volatile result fields
